name: Open WebUI Computer (Rootless AI Agent)
install_cmd: if ! command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'ERROR: Python 3 is required.' >&2; exit 1; fi; python3 -c 'import sys; raise SystemExit(0 if sys.version_info >= (3,10) else 1)' || { echo 'ERROR: Python 3.10 or newer is required.' >&2; exit 1; }; if ! python3 -m pip --version >/dev/null 2>&1; then python3 -m ensurepip --user || { echo 'ERROR: pip is unavailable and ensurepip is disabled by the host.' >&2; exit 1; }; fi; mkdir -p storage data; if [ ! -x storage/venv/bin/python ]; then python3 -m venv storage/venv 2>/dev/null || { python3 -m pip install --user --upgrade virtualenv && python3 -m virtualenv storage/venv; }; fi; storage/venv/bin/python -m pip install --upgrade pip wheel; storage/venv/bin/python -m pip install --upgrade cptr; echo 'Open WebUI Computer installed without sudo, apt, or Docker.'
start_cmd: mkdir -p data; export CPTR_DATA_DIR="$PWD/data"; exec storage/venv/bin/cptr run --host 0.0.0.0 --port "${PORT:-8000}" --headless
